thread:
kelly: small emergency  onboarding e2e failing — invite emails not sent when creating teams via the JS SDK. Anyone seen this?

 diego: I can repro. Direct REST POST to /v1/admin/teams with {"name":"beta-team","invite_users":true} creates invites. SDK call `client.admin.createTeam({name: 'beta-team', inviteUsers: true})` returns 200 but no invites are created.

 priyanka: Can you paste the outbound request the SDK makes?

 diego: Captured from dev proxy: outbound body is `{"name":"beta-team"}`  the `inviteUsers` property is completely missing. Token scopes are correct (admin:teams).

 rachel: That's probably a generator/serializer regression. We recently updated the codegen templates to tighten param validation; looks like admin namespace lost automatic camelCase -> snake_case mapping.

 kelly: Minimal repro (JS):
```js
// JS SDK
await client.admin.createTeam({
  name: 'beta-team',
  inviteUsers: true // expected to trigger invites
});
```
Working curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/teams \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"beta-team","invite_users":true}'
```

 priyanka: Two related issues to track: (A) serializer drops camelCase fields for admin routes; (B) retry behavior mismatch  SDK runtime currently retries on 409 and treats some 4xx as retriable which REST clients don't. That leads to duplicate invite attempts in logs.

 diego: Proposed short-term mitigation: patch sampleapp onboarding to call the admin REST endpoint directly for createTeam (unblocked e2e). Long-term fixes: generator change to ensure camelCase->snake_case mapping for admin params, and update retry classifier to treat 4xx (400..499) as non-retriable by default except 429. Add per-endpoint override flags in runtime for special cases.

 rachel: Agreed. Also add an integration test that exercises invite flow end-to-end using SDK, so we don't regress again.

 kelly: I opened an internal ticket: https://redwood.internal/p/SDK-DX-873 to track serializer parity, retry semantics, sampleapp workaround, and tests.

 priyanka: I'll draft two PRs: (1) generator template change to include admin param mapping + unit tests; (2) runtime change to retry classification + endpoint override config + tests.

 build-bot: CI: PR #4782 created by priyanka  unit tests queued, integration scheduled.

 diego: Once PRs land, I'll revert sampleapp workaround and run the full onboarding e2e.

 kelly: Thanks team. Quick note: for any transient 409s server-side, please return Retry-After so the client can make an informed retry decision. For now, default to not retrying client errors. :thumbsup:
